title: What did Java 17 add overall, and why do teams adopt it (LTS stability + modern features)?
keyPoints: Java 17 is an LTS release that finalizes records, sealed classes, pattern matching instanceof, switch expressions, and text blocks
Records (JEP 395) are immutable data carriers that auto-generate constructor, accessors, equals, hashCode, and toString
Sealed classes (JEP 409) restrict which types can extend or implement a type, enabling exhaustive switch
Pattern matching instanceof (JEP 394) combines type check and cast: if (obj instanceof Trade t)
Switch expressions (JEP 361) return values with arrow syntax and no fall-through
Text blocks (JEP 378) provide clean multi-line strings without escape characters
Spring Boot 3.x requires Java 17 as the minimum version, making it the enterprise baseline

s1_definition.oneliner: Java 17 is an LTS release that finalizes records, sealed classes, pattern matching instanceof, switch expressions, and text blocks as the modern enterprise baseline.
s1_definition.profdef:
- **Records (JEP 395)** – immutable data carriers: `record Trade(String id, BigDecimal amount) {}` auto-generates constructor, accessors, `equals()`, `hashCode()`, and `toString()`.
- **Sealed classes (JEP 409)** – restrict inheritance to a known set of subtypes: `sealed interface Instruction permits Buy, Sell`, enabling exhaustive handling in switch.
- **Pattern matching instanceof (JEP 394)** – combines type check and cast in one expression: `if (obj instanceof Trade t) { use t; }`.
- **Switch expressions (JEP 361)** – return values, arrow syntax without fall-through, `yield` for blocks.
- **Text blocks (JEP 378)** – triple-quoted multi-line strings without escape characters.
- **Strong encapsulation** – JDK internals are strongly encapsulated; illegal reflective access is denied by default.
s1_definition.analogy: Java 17 is the bank's infrastructure upgrade that every branch must adopt. Records replace handwritten forms with pre-printed templates. Sealed classes restrict which departments can issue certain documents. Pattern matching instanceof is a combined ID check and entry pass. The whole upgrade simplifies daily operations while maintaining strict security.

sections.s6_takeaway:
Java 17 is the LTS release that brings modern language features to enterprise Java. Records eliminate POJO boilerplate with auto-generated constructors, accessors, equals, hashCode, and toString. Sealed classes restrict inheritance to a known set of subtypes, enabling the compiler to enforce exhaustive switch handling. Pattern matching instanceof combines type check and cast in one expression.

Together, records plus sealed classes plus pattern matching give Java algebraic-data-type modeling for the first time. You define a sealed hierarchy of records, then use an exhaustive switch to handle each variant. Adding a new record subtype without updating all switches is a compile error, eliminating a class of runtime bugs.

Teams adopt Java 17 because Spring Boot 3.x requires it, it is LTS with years of support, and the productivity gains from records alone justify the upgrade. The path from Java 8 or 11 to 17 is the most common enterprise migration in progress today.

Remember one sentence: Java 17 LTS finalizes records, sealed classes, and pattern matching instanceof as the enterprise baseline required by Spring Boot 3.x.
